title: How VLMs Plan What's Next
abstract: arXiv:2611.21600v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching

translated_title: 视觉语言模型如何规划下一步
translated_abstract: 当视觉语言模型描述一幅图像时，它会逐个命名对象，并且很少重复自己，然而模型如何规划这种顺序却远非显而易见。我们刻画了视觉语言模型在“看”之前决定“看哪里”的机制。该机制有四个主要部分：首先，绑定头将相关文本词元与图像进行匹配，并将其解析为指向匹配图像区域的指针；其次，同样的绑定头将每个已写出的答案与其来源区域绑定，模型将其转化为一个进度信号——一个光标，即列表已经写到图像中的哪个位置；第三，选择步骤选取光标之后最近的未写区域，或者停止；最后，注视头执行所选指针并返回该处所绘内容的概念，语言头和后期多层感知机将其转化为用问题语言表达的一个词。我们通过因果补丁实验验证了该机制的每个部分。
tldr: 本文揭示了视觉语言模型通过“绑定头匹配—进度光标—区域选择—注视头执行”四个阶段来规划描述图像时的观察与输出顺序，并利用因果补丁实验逐一验证了各环节的作用。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that VLMs plan their enumeration order when describing images through a four-part mechanism—binding heads, a progress cursor, a selection step, and gaze heads—validated component-by-component via causal patching.
